scope.product: Cover Letter Template That Gets Read
scope.window: Most recent 30 days ending 2026-08-20; bounded by Chief of Staff to the latest six evaluable transactions

eligibilityRule: Include a unique purchaser only when transaction-level purchase proof exists, an email is present, no duplicate is selected, and an independently supported mailbox-deliverability, prior-follow-up, reply, unsubscribe, and suppression review does not exclude the buyer. Stan's transaction-delivery state alone is not a global mailbox-deliverability determination.

aggregate.reasonMailboxChecksNotPerformed: The bounded review did not perform the independent mailbox-history and suppression checks required to determine cohort eligibility.

measurementDefinitions.diagnosticReplyRate: Unique purchasers with a substantive diagnostic reply / unique purchasers receiving the diagnostic message; exclude delivery failures from the denominator.
measurementDefinitions.qualifiedSegmentRate: Unique replying purchasers assigned one approved problem segment / unique substantive diagnostic repliers.
measurementDefinitions.routedOfferClickRate: Unique purchasers clicking the single routed approved offer link / unique purchasers sent that routed offer link; require buyer-level tagged-link evidence.
measurementDefinitions.purchaseRate: Unique purchasers with transaction-proven pilot-attributable purchase / unique purchasers sent the routed offer link.
measurementDefinitions.revenue: Gross USD from transaction-proven pilot-attributable purchases; report refunds separately and do not infer from rolling-window totals.
measurementDefinitions.complaintRate: Unique purchasers submitting a complaint / unique purchasers receiving any pilot message.
measurementDefinitions.unsubscribeRate: Unique purchasers unsubscribing after pilot contact / unique purchasers receiving any pilot message.

limitations: Exact UI context: the dialog is titled Undelivered Transaction and includes Bounce Reason: Unknown, Send email to, and Resend. This supports a transaction-delivery-email failure interpretation.
The UI does not label the address itself globally undeliverable and does not establish future outreach-email deliverability.
Prior-follow-up, reply, unsubscribe, and suppression status were not assessed; cohort eligibility is therefore not determined.
The audit authorizes no outreach and makes no causal or individual attribution from rolling-window order totals.
